notes.note: Frame shows the earlier wording 'Open session' (link beside Close in the inspector); the UI now says 'Open chat'. The blocked-state paragraphs this branch reworded (answers needed, cannot respond, too many unconfirmed decisions, decision already attempted) are not shown in this frame, which shows the actionable state with Deny and Approve once. Kept as a historical illustration of request inspection; layout and controls are otherwise unchanged by this branch.

Viewed via frames extracted with Playwright Chromium at 0.5s, 3s, 5s, 7s, 9s, 11s, 13s and 14.0s (ffmpeg not installed). Frame shows the earlier wording 'Open session' (link beside Close in the inspector, collapsed and with Request identity expanded); the UI now says 'Open chat'. The reworded blocked-state paragraphs do not appear; the recording shows the actionable state with Deny and Approve once, then the closed Notifications page. Kept as a historical illustration of request inspection; layout and controls are otherwise unchanged by this branch.

Changed lines in NewChatModal.tsx don't appear in this frame (frame shows the pre-redesign New chat composer at 390px with a selected Codex agent, the project control, Start and Continue working rows). The changed strings are the engine-setup loading and empty states ('Preparing the engine', 'The engine is still starting', 'Connect an engine'), the no-agent empty hint (now NO_AGENT_SETUP_HINT) and the agent search placeholder ('Search agents…'), none of which render here.
